capabilities: render selected text as a styled image
preview the image with zoom controls
copy the image to the clipboard
extras: The README is mostly a version changelog and is partly in Chinese; no usage instructions beyond the one-line description.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a text selection into a shareable image for pasting into chats or social media.
summary: Renders selected note text as a styled image that can be copied or downloaded for sharing.
